bounded_scope_note: Season-scale run: this report covers the FULL 2023-Q corpus of covered circuits present in the G2-consolidated slice (parked/error-only rounds excluded). Epic #659 gate g3 / issue #670.

instrument4.composability_limitation: The on-disk driver_class_observables/reference_laps grain is by corner-severity CLASS (straight/braking_zone/severity:c0-c3) -- a TIME-SHARE partition of the WHOLE lap, not a geographic segment tiling assigned to an FIA sector. A severity class spans corners across MULTIPLE FIA sectors, and no class->sector mapping exists in this DB-only slice (building one needs telemetry-derived segment tiling via derive_sector_lines/nest_sectors, which requires FastF1/telemetry access -- explicitly out of scope here, no FastF1 online). Therefore a genuine PER-SECTOR composed prediction CANNOT be constructed from this slice's granularity. This gap is routed to #670. What IS computable instead: a WHOLE-LAP (single pseudo-sector spanning all 6 classes) composed prediction, reported below -- clearly NOT a per-FIA-sector result.

split_scheme_note: Split scheme: ROTATING-BLOCK (circle-method) deterministic, seed-free, balanced split-half -- circuits sorted into a fixed canonical (alphabetical) order c_0..c_{n-1}; for k=0..(n/2-1), half_a(k) = the contiguous window of n/2 circuits at positions [k..k+n/2-1] (mod n), half_b(k) = the complement. This yields K=n/2 distinct balanced partitions (no random/seed). r is AVERAGED over the K partitions, then the SAME registered per-class channel decision rule (imported r_floor + channel_tie_margin, decide_channel_from_mean_r) is re-applied to the averaged r -- the direct N-circuit generalization of the #668 4-circuit exhaustive-2v2-averaged-over-3-partitions scheme.
